race.comment: STATE IN TEXAS (4) is the one to beat despite a ninth at Eagle Farm last start, that BM78 was Saturday company and maps well again with the senior rider engaged. No surprise to see him return to form. LADY WARDELL (3) poses the main threat with the claim after she was held up at Coffs Harbour.  Assess on the strong Open third at Lismore behind At Witz End. Proven at 1010m and on wet tracks. DIAMANTINA ROSE (6) consistent mare in career-best form. Looks up to this stronger contest after winning by two lengths at this track in a BM66. Drops in weight and worth noting STATE IN TEXAS had her measure at Ipswich two starts back. SAMMY CONQUERS ALL (1) next best in a small field.
